fusions.name: Brought to Bay
fusions.desc: Hurls a blow at a target at or below 30% health up to 6 tiles away, which deals 26 damage, rising to 1.2 times that at full range.

fusions.name: Driving Blow
fusions.desc: Sends a bolt of force into the first enemy it meets, which deals 4 damage, with a 30% chance to leave it [Marked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Close for the Kill
fusions.desc: Your damage rises 25% for 10 seconds, and your movement speed rises 20% for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Quarry's Scent
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying a condition, you deal 12% more damage.
